exchanges: Good morning. I'm trying to get organized for the week and could use a sounding board.
Good morning! Happy to help. What's on the schedule?
Mateo has baseball practice Monday and Wednesday, and Lucía has her reading tutor on Tuesday.
That's a full week already. Who's doing the driving?
Mostly me. My wife works evenings at the hospital, so I'm on pickup duty.
That's a lot of solo driving. Do you get any help from family?
My sister Inés helps sometimes. She's a pharmacist, so her hours are actually pretty regular.
Regular hours make her a handy backup. Does she live close by?
About ten minutes away. The kids love going over because she has a parrot that swears in Spanish.
That would be the highlight of any kid's week. Hopefully it has a small vocabulary.
Ha, it does not. Anyway, Mateo's team has a tournament in Kingston at the end of the month.
A weekend away for a tournament can be fun. Will you stay overnight?
Probably one night. The coach, Mr. Brennan, is organizing a hotel block.
That makes it easier. Is the whole team going?
Most of them. One boy, Dev, can't make it because his family is flying to India for a wedding.
That's a big trip. Mateo will probably miss him in the lineup.
Dev is their best pitcher, so yes. Lucía is less interested in baseball. She'd rather be upside down on the couch.
Some kids just need to move. Has she tried anything like tumbling?
That's the thing. Since the Olympics she's been begging for gymnastics, and we finally signed her up at a place near the library.
That's a great fit for a kid who's always upside down. How did the first class go?
She came home glowing. The coach there competed for Romania years ago and is very intense.
Intense coaches can be inspiring if they're encouraging too. Sounds like she's hooked.
She is. Mateo, meanwhile, had strep throat last week and missed three days of school.
Poor kid. Is he feeling better now?
Much better. The antibiotics worked fast. His teacher, Ms. Yamamoto, sent home a packet so he could catch up.
That's thoughtful of her. A packet is much easier than a pile of emails.
Agreed. My sister-in-law Marisol, my wife's younger sister, offered to take the kids one Saturday so we can have a break.
That's generous. A Saturday off sounds well earned.
She's a veterinarian, so the kids are begging to visit the clinic. Lucía wants to hold a puppy.
That would make the Saturday a big event. Hopefully there's a puppy around.
I said Kingston for Mateo's tournament earlier, but I just reread the email. It's in Peterborough.
Good catch before you booked anything. Is Mr. Brennan's hotel block still on?
Yes, he set it up there. I need to book by Friday.
Worth doing today so it's off your list.
Done. Now I'm thinking about lunches. Mateo will only eat pasta with butter.
Plain pasta is a classic. Does Lucía eat the same way?
No, she's the opposite. She'll eat sushi, curry, anything spicy. She gets that from my wife.
An adventurous eater makes lunches more fun. A thermos might help Mateo branch out slowly.
Maybe. Ms. Yamamoto says he trades half his lunch anyway.
Then at least someone's enjoying it. Trading might be how he tries new things.
True. Unrelated, but our neighbour Olumide asked if Mateo could mow his lawn for pocket money.
That's a nice first job for a twelve-year-old. Is Mateo up for it?
He's thrilled. He wants to save up for a new glove.
Saving for something specific is a great motivator.
He's already made a chart on the fridge.
That's commitment. Charts on the fridge get things done.
Lucía made a chart too, but hers is just horse stickers.
Every chart has its purpose. Horses count.
Oh, I almost forgot. Lucía's reading tutor, Mrs. Ferreira, is moving to Vancouver in the spring.
That's a loss if Lucía likes her. Will she help you find someone new?
She said she'd recommend a colleague. Lucía is going to be sad though.
Kids do bounce back, and a good recommendation helps a lot.
I hope so. She only started liking books because of her.
That's a real gift. Whoever comes next will have a good foundation to build on.

questions.message: What does my sister-in-law do for work again?
What's the new sport Lucía picked up?
The tournament is in Peterborough, isn't it? I want to double-check before I pack.
Where is Mrs. Ferreira relocating to?
What does Olumide do for a living?
Yeah, a fresh face might even be good for her.
